$comment: GENERATED by ggen from the admitted aic:ContractType graph. Do not edit.

admission_decision.description: An independently adjudicated verdict on a subject (e.g. a tool_intent), carrying a typed reason and the policy identity it was decided under.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this admission decision.

subject_id.description: Identifier of the subject (e.g. a tool_intent or candidate_claim) being decided on.

principal_id.description: Identifier of the principal the decision was made on behalf of.

typed_reason.description: Typed reason code explaining the verdict.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the policy evaluated to reach this verdict.

policy_version.description: Version of the policy evaluated to reach this verdict.

candidate_claim.description: A candidate factual claim produced by a research task, linked to the evidence that supports or contradicts it.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier for this candidate claim.

task_id.description: Identifier of the research task that produced this claim.

statement.description: The natural-language statement of the claim.

support_evidence_ids.description: Evidence identifiers cited as supporting this claim.

contradict_evidence_ids.description: Evidence identifiers cited as contradicting this claim.

confidence.description: Model-estimated confidence in the claim, in the range [0,1].

semantic_status.description: Closed-vocabulary semantic status of the claim (e.g. supported, contradicted, unverified).

evidence_envelope.description: A content-addressed unit of ingested evidence, carrying provenance, access-control, and redaction metadata for downstream research and grounding.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence envelope.

source_uri.description: URI the evidence was retrieved from.

source_kind.description: Kind of source (e.g. web, document, api, sensor).

content_hash.description: Content-addressed hash of the evidence payload.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the underlying content.

modality.description: Modality of the evidence (e.g. text, image, audio, video, structured).

observed_at.description: Timestamp the underlying event/content was observed.

acl_labels.description: Access-control labels gating who may read this evidence.

canonical_entity_ids.description: Canonical entity identifiers this evidence resolves to.

redaction_class.description: Redaction/sensitivity classification applied to this evidence.

schema_version.description: Schema version this envelope conforms to.

evidence_hit.description: One scored retrieval result linking a query to an evidence_envelope.

hit_id.description: Unique identifier for this retrieval hit.

query_id.description: Identifier of the query that produced this hit.

evidence_id.description: Identifier of the evidence_envelope this hit resolves to.

score.description: Relevance score assigned to this hit by the retrieval method.

retrieval_method.description: Identifier of the retrieval method that produced this hit (e.g. bm25, dense, hybrid).

rank.description: Rank position of this hit within its query's result set.

model_call_receipt.description: Deterministic evidence binding a single model-gateway call's request and response identities, for replay and audit.

call_id.description: Unique identifier for this model call receipt.

provider_profile.description: Identifier of the model provider/gateway profile used.

model_id_or_snapshot.description: Model identifier or pinned snapshot used for this call.

request_hash.description: Content hash of the canonicalized request.

response_hash.description: Content hash of the canonicalized response.

prompt_template_id.description: Identifier of the prompt template used to construct the request.

prompt_template_version.description: Version of the prompt template used to construct the request.

latency_ms.description: Observed end-to-end latency of the call, in milliseconds.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier correlating this call with other records.

research_task.description: A bounded research request issued by a principal, scoping freshness, privacy, and resource limits for the work it authorizes.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this research task.

principal_id.description: Identifier of the principal that issued this task.

query.description: The research query/prompt driving this task.

freshness_requirement.description: Required recency of evidence used to answer the query.

privacy_class.description: Privacy classification bounding what evidence/tools may be used.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens the task's model calls may consume.

max_tool_calls.description: Maximum number of tool invocations permitted for this task.

output_contract.description: Identifier of the output contract the answer must satisfy.

policy_version.description: Version of the governing policy this task was admitted under.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier linking this task to related records.

tool_intent.description: A proposed tool invocation awaiting admission. Carries no execution authority of any kind -- authority and admission are the exclusive responsibility of the concurrent beam4pm-post-llm-runtime-pack's rt: vocabulary; this type is inert data describing what a caller would like to do.

intent_id.description: Unique identifier for this tool intent.

task_id.description: Identifier of the research task this intent was proposed for.

tool_id.description: Identifier of the tool this intent targets.

canonical_args_hash.description: Content hash of the canonicalized tool arguments.

side_effect_class.description: Declared side-effect class of the intended call (e.g. read, write, external).

required_capability.description: Capability label this intent would require if authorized. Descriptive only -- confers no authority itself; see the scope note on aic:tool_intent above.

dry_run.description: Whether this intent is a dry-run/simulation rather than a live proposal.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for de-duplicating repeated proposals of this intent.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this intent record (e.g. proposed, withdrawn, superseded).
